item.title: Blockchain.com Deploys AI Compliance for UK Crypto Marketing
item.summary: Blockchain.com has partnered with Adclear to introduce artificial intelligence-powered compliance checks across its United Kingdom marketing operations, as the cryptocurrency industry prepares for tighter regulatory requirements scheduled to take effect in October 2027.
